We design and build web applications for small companies. Each project starts with a short discovery call, followed by a written plan, a fixed timeline and weekly demos, so that the client always knows what is happening and what comes next. After launch we monitor errors, fix bugs quickly and report every month on speed and uptime using public tools that the client can also open and check for themselves at any time. Our pricing is published openly: a typical small website takes four to six weeks and starts at a fixed fee that we agree in writing before any work begins, with no hidden costs, and every client receives the source code and full documentation.

Leads rose 40% from 100 to 140 per month in Jan-Jun 2025 (source: Google Analytics export).
